description: Send one OpenAI chat completions request to a compatible endpoint; returns the assistant message, usage and the model that answered. Errors: ArgumentsBad, EndpointFailed, ReplyBad. Agents normally do not call this: their brain goes through the llm kernel (memory node brain).

endpoint.description: one endpoint: url (up to /v1), model, key (optional), fixed (optional fields that override the request); model always comes from here

request.description: an OpenAI chat completions body without the endpoint: messages required; tools, temperature, model optional
